cohort: 5836 neonates born at an Australian tertiary hospital in 2019
finding: Maternal country of birth (Vietnam, Sudan, Samoa, Philippines), speaking a language other than the main language, caesarean or assisted vaginal birth, mixed feeding or formula for the first feed, and Newborn Services admission were associated with lower odds of exclusive breastfeeding on discharge.
mod_finding: Caesarean or assisted vaginal birth was associated with lower odds of exclusive breastfeeding on discharge.
